name: Sunf Pu Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Sunf Pu Technology Co., Ltd., based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan, is dedicated to the innovation, production, and worldwide distribution of a comprehensive range of wiring and cabling solutions. Established in 1983, the company's extensive product portfolio includes various types of cables for networking (like LAN), digital video and audio transmission (such as DVI, HDMI, and DisplayPort), and specialized components like coil, assembly, and integrated cables. They also provide essential connectivity items including USB cables, patch cords, and pull box units.
